text: My husband, son and daughter are also Asian. And we all understand the need for Israel to be a Jewish Democracy with a Jewish Majority. I'm so happy to hear you haven't experienced discrimination. But there are many many immigrants who are treated differently - especially as soon as we leave the Tel Aviv border. I also agree with immigration to have strict rules. I just don't agree that they should act in any dehumanizing ways to foreigners because it creeps into the culture. The fact that you haven't experienced that is great. But it is common practice here. I don't think this is political. I'm not a super lefty or anything. I'm just talking human to human.
